name: Summitbound
source:
You have been plucked from the Scholomance, a magic university-meets-prison, for a chance to graduate and receive your mage licence.

As you face your last examinations in potions, artificing, and combat, you draw closer to five fellow students — Melody, Aria, Xander, Rex, and Tao — each guarding lofty ambitions, deep wounds, and dark secrets.

In this world, no mage escapes the authority of the Scholomance. Those who refuse its teachings are branded rogue mages and hunted without mercy. Only the most gifted are chosen to ascend to The Summit for their 7-day long final exam — selected by aptitude, not by year group — and this single week determines the course of their lives. Graduation is not a celebration, but a judgment. 

Can you pass your final exams?

[From [url=https://team-rat-games.itch.io/summitbound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经从通灵学院（一所魔法大学与监狱的结合）中被拉出来，有机会毕业并获得法师执照。

当你面临魔药、炼器和战斗方面的最后考试时，你与五名同学的关系越来越近——梅洛迪、阿里亚、桑德、雷克斯和陶——每个人都守护着崇高的野心、深深的伤口和黑暗的秘密。

在这个世界上，没有法师能够逃脱通灵学院的权威。那些拒绝其教义的人会被贴上流氓法师的标签，并被毫不留情地追捕。只有最有天赋的人才会被选入The Summit参加为期7天的期末考试（根据能力而非年级进行选择），而这一周就决定了他们的人生轨迹。毕业不是庆祝，而是判断。

你能通过期末考试吗？

[来自[url=https://team-rat-games.itch.io/summitbound]itch.io[/url]]
